title: Top Products
description: Begins with an everyday explanation, then traces its in sql/top_products.sql. Source units combined: Top Products.

learning_objectives.text: Explain top products in plain language using the project source.
Trace `its` in `sql/top_products.sql` and explain its inputs, behavior, and output.
